name: general.plan.enabled
description: Enable Plan Mode so planning can use a read-only safety boundary before implementation.

examples.explanation: Keep Plan Mode available in Gemini CLI.

when_to_use: Use when users should be able to plan without write-capable implementation tools.

conditions: Changing this setting requires a restart.

name: model.name
description: Set the Gemini model used for conversations by default.
when_to_use: Use when automatic model selection is not appropriate for most sessions.

conditions: The configured model must be available to the account.

name: security.folderTrust.enabled
description: Enable Gemini CLI's folder-trust tracking for workspaces.

examples.explanation: Require trust decisions for workspace-controlled configuration.

when_to_use: Keep enabled when opening repositories whose local configuration should not be trusted automatically.
when_not_to_use: Do not disable folder trust merely to suppress a prompt in unfamiliar repositories.

conditions: Changing this setting requires a restart.
